title: Platform safe-area checker
summary: Profile-driven safe areas for vertical and landscape video (house conservative defaults, custom JSON profiles) with text-box checks and a clamped caption band.
description: Built-in margins are this project's own conservative defaults, not platform specifications: platform UI guidance changes and could not be verified from official sources on 2026-10-10. Load current official numbers as a custom profile.

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
